name: V Villas Hua Hin - MGallery Collection
short_description: A 28-villa private beachfront retreat near central Hua Hin with 24-hour butler service and a 4.8/5 ALL rating.
ai_summary: V Villas Hua Hin sits on Hua Hin's beach near the town centre, close to shopping centres, Cicada Market, golf courses, and water parks. Its own Accor listing shows a 4.8/5 ALL guest rating from roughly 223 reviews -- among the highest of any Accor property researched in this batch. The resort has 28 exclusive pool villas with 24-hour butler service, suited to couples, small groups, or larger family gatherings.

faqs.question: How many villas does V Villas Hua Hin have?
faqs.answer: 28 exclusive pool villas, each with 24-hour butler service, located on Hua Hin's beach near the town centre. It's one of the highest-rated Accor properties researched in Hua Hin, with a 4.8/5 ALL guest rating from roughly 223 reviews, and sits close to Cicada Market, golf courses, and water parks.
